curation.name: Impulse Ball Kick (Right Foot)
curation.summary: One-shot dynamic kick with the right foot designed to strike a 70mm / 15g ball forward while maintaining single-leg biped balance.
curation.details: Publisher materials describe a ball-blind, short impulse-kick maneuver for a lightweight practice ball.
curation.notes: The target ball and hardware claims are publisher context, not independent registry evidence.
